name: Omocha Kendama
description: Omocha Kendama — a store theme for a small wooden toy shop and turning workshop, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Sumi (#1C1C1C) is the main colour: the masthead, the hero, the feature spread, every page head and the footer are sumi fields with bone type and beech and kendama-red marks; Zen Kurenaido for display and Work Sans for reading. It is laid out like a small magazine: an issue strip in the header, a menu that opens as a full-screen overlay of numbered links, a product-grid hero of film photographs where a cut-out kendama swings out of the headline cell across the grid lines and a cut-out spinning top rises out of the last strip, then the contents of the issue, a two-column feature with a pull quote, the toy shelf and the journal. All photographs are generated in one 35mm film-grain direction graded toward sumi. The shop details and the wood-and-care notes each live in one synced pattern (WooCommerce optional: without it the toys show as static cells and orders go by email).
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-15 (editorial-magazine, product-grid-hero, overlay nav, real-photography images, film-grain photo direction, sumi #1C1C1C, Zen Kurenaido + Work Sans). Every picture is a photorealistic 35mm film-grain photograph generated with Grok Build and graded toward sumi; the kendama and the spinning top are also transparent cut-outs that break out of the hero grid. Contrast: bone #EEEAE2 on sumi #1C1C1C 14.2:1 (all text on the sumi masthead, hero, feature, page heads, bands and footer); ash #B9B3A8 on sumi 8.2:1; beech #D8B88A on sumi 9.0:1 (labels, buttons, drop caps; sumi on beech buttons 9.0:1); light red #E86A4E on sumi 5.4:1 (numbers and emphasis); sumi on paper #F3F1EC 15.1:1; deep red links #9C2A1C on paper 6.7:1; stone #57534B on paper 6.8:1; kendama red #C0392B on paper 4.8:1 (large numbers and marks).

summary.zh-TW: 墨色雜誌風的木製玩具店：底片質感的商品格狀主視覺，去背劍玉與陀螺破格而出，全螢幕覆蓋選單。
summary.en: A sumi-black wooden toy shop laid out like a magazine: film photos in a product grid, cut-out kendama breaking it, overlay menu.
summary.ja: 墨色の雑誌風・木のおもちゃ店。フィルム写真の商品グリッドから切り抜きのけん玉と独楽が飛び出し、全画面メニュー。
summary.fr: Boutique de jouets en bois noir sumi, mise en page de magazine : grille de photos argentiques, kendama détouré qui déborde.
summary.de: Holzspielzeugladen in Sumi-Schwarz im Magazin-Layout: Filmfotos im Produktraster, ein freigestelltes Kendama bricht heraus.
